title: WWE October Prime Day Deals 2026: Save Up to 50% on WWE Merch Online
summary: Here's how to shop deep discounts on all sorts of WWE gear online.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With WWE Money in the Bank coming up this week, ShopBillboard rounded up the best deals on WWE merch during Prime Big Deal Days (October Prime Day) on Amazon. The 48-hour shopping event starts on Tuesday (Oct. 6) and ends the following day on Wednesday (Oct. 7) and has a wide range of deep discounts on WWE gear.

Whether you’ve been there from the very beginning or you just discovered the joys of pro wrestling, we spotted deals on all sorts of merch to show off your love for the WWE. In fact, you can save up to 50% on Amazon to shop action figures, wall calendars, signed photographs and other items. There is even an insulated fanny pack that’s shaped like a WWE championship belt that’s on sale for $33 (was $45) from the retail giant.

Scroll down and shop the best WWE merch you can shop on Amazon during Prime Big Deal Days.

And since this WWE merch is from Amazon, you’ll get it shipped to you for free if you’re a Prime member. Otherwise, your cart has to be more than $35 to get free shipping.

Additionally, WWE Monday in the Bank takes place on Saturday, Oct. 10. It broadcasts live from Saturday, Oct. 10, at the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, Louisiana, while the WWE event is available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited .
